lines.text: Via delle Fornaci 7 · Borgo Valdorso (TO) · Production plant
Commissioning record EQ-2011-006 - finished goods warehouse M5
New heated warehouse M5: 2,400 pallet positions; gas heating with BMS alarm;
minimum internal temperature 12 °C guaranteed all year.
From 1 November 2011 all finished goods are stored in M5.
Warehouse M2 will be used for empty packaging and pallets only.
Acceptance: heating test 72 h at -8 °C external, internal 14.5 °C minimum - passed.
